- Predisposing factors: Family history of lung cancer (mother), potentially heightening concern about cancer.
- Precipitating factors: Onset of sore throat, dry cough, and mild shortness of breath over the past week.
- Perpetuating factors: Variable symptom course (better/worse) and online health searches increasing worry; decreased appetite contributing to concern.
- Protective factors: Engaged with care, requested advice and reassurance, received safety-net guidance and sick note.
